body:
The fresh 2026-11-07 KG-Microbe MediaDive node export retains `mediadive.ingredient:1315` with the label `Na acetate x 3 H2O`. MIM already has the exact sodium acetate trihydrate identity, `CHEBI:32138`, in `data/ingredients/mapped/Sodium_Acetate_Trihydrate.yaml`, but its accepted hydrate alias is `Na-acetate x 3 H2O` and the space spelling is absent.

Primary evidence inspected on 2026-11-08 UTC (2026-11-07 local):
- [MediaDive ingredient 1315](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/download/ingredient/1315/json) explicitly pairs the exact source label with CAS 6131-90-4.
- [ChEBI CHEBI:32138](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/CHEBI:32138), inspected through its OLS API record, is sodium acetate trihydrate with CAS 6131-90-4 and three water components in its formula and InChI.
- [PubChem CID 23665404](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/23665404), inspected through PUG REST, corroborates the trihydrate CAS and name.

This resolves the earlier `hydrate_review` requirement for source confirmation for this exact raw spelling. It does not release other raw-form holds, preparations, anhydrous sodium acetate or variable hydrates. The MediaDive formula has an extra hydrogen relative to ChEBI; retain that source discrepancy as provenance and do not copy it into MIM chemistry.

The source checkout is `kg-microbe-mim-1788-20261107`, read-only, at f10fb3909ed32898a54176ca77e509a950d16b84. Its consumed reviewed MIM export is already from MIM 0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4, so this is an absent source spelling, not an unconsumed old mapping. Current MIM canonical position 2556 is supported; any owner-byte change must withdraw inherited support through the native receipt chain. A fresh mapping-only assessment must bind the exact new row, all six alias tokens, current owner and evidence before support may return. No role or whole-record scientific approval is implied.

Acceptance: guarded source-alias write and history; synchronized YAML and generated surfaces; native SSSOM generation and explicit scoped publication; immutable row/owner receipt; complete supported/withheld candidate exports and companion provenance; full source-bound triage ledger including rare MicrobeDecoder compounds; required validation and independent final review. The KG-Microbe inputs/build remain unchanged; downstream adoption requires its own review and no merge or rebuild is part of this task.
title: Curate the verified MediaDive sodium acetate trihydrate spelling and preserve export review boundaries
